lines.zh: 甲缝里冒着气，我往前走。
lines.en: Ki leaks from my seams as I advance.

lines.zh: 强化之后，脚步反而更沉。
lines.en: Powered up, my steps land heavier.
An afterimage lingers where I stood.
One stride clears the whole staircase.
The ground sinks under my tread.
Ki trails behind me in a line.
I need not be fast, only close.

lines.zh: 这一带的风都被我推开。
lines.en: The wind here parts around me.
The stones shiver with my steps.
I walk at half my strength.
Something in me keeps rising.
The road ahead is three steps long.
I stand still and ki rises off me.
The cracks in my armor have closed.
Powering up this body costs something.
My breath carries the sound of fire.
I am growing used to this strength.
I wait a while before I move.
Ki pools in a ring at my feet.
This plate is far harder than before.

lines.zh: 我掌心的气团转了半圈。
lines.en: The ki in my palm turns half a circle.
The tiles bear cracks where I stood.

lines.zh: 我能听见自己血管里的声。
lines.en: I can hear the sound in my own veins.
Every stone here is growing hot.
One moment more and the ki will settle.
I do not like this form.
You should grasp the gap now.

lines.zh: 我比刚才高了一头的气。
lines.en: My ki stands a head above before.
You are backing further than last time.
Your hand shakes; that is natural.

lines.zh: 这一身气不是用来吓人的。
lines.en: This ki is not for frightening people.

lines.zh: 你的武器碰不到我的甲。
lines.en: Your weapon cannot reach my plate.
Your eyes tell me everything.
You are still measuring distance.
Accuracy will not save you.
You have seen my speed.
The afterimages will fool your eyes.
You could still walk away.
You planted your feet; good.
I do not intend to hold back.

lines.zh: 甲缝里冒着气，我一步跨过石阶。
lines.en: Ki seeps from my seams; one step clears the stair.
This form will not last long.
So I must be quick.
That you still stand is a small surprise.

lines.zh: 气乱了一瞬，我又压回去。
lines.en: The ki falters; I force it back.

lines.zh: 甲上的裂口冒出一缕烟。
lines.en: A thread of smoke rises from the crack.
I took that one.
My body reminds me of the limit.
Half a step back, and brick crumbles.
The pain is clearer than usual.
I press my chest.
While the ki holds, I stand.
Your arm has real force.
This form does not let me be slow.
This body has no need of food.
The smell scatters before it reaches me.
I cannot even feel hunger.
Hold it farther away.
Keep it; you may need it later.
I cannot swallow anything in this state.
The ki burns the smell away.
I just want this finished.
That will not help you.
Put it away; do not waste it.
You hit me and the ki shoves you off.
I did not even feel it.
Back off; the plate is hot.
Standing close to me will burn you.
You stepped on my afterimage.
I barely shifted.

lines.zh: 这一层气挡着，你过不来。
lines.en: This layer of ki keeps you out.
You hit me and bounce off my aura.
Your hand is smoking.
Standing farther off is better for you.
Not in this form.

lines.zh: 我的身体正在被气占满。
lines.en: My body is filling with ki.
There is no room for other thoughts.
Too late for such talk.
I can barely hold myself together.
Survive first, then speak.
This form has a time limit.
Do not spend your mind here.
I do not have that time.
Stand clear.

lines.zh: 我低头，气把东西推开了。
lines.en: I stoop and the ki pushes it away.
I pick it up; my palm burns.
I have crushed it in my grip.
Take it back; I cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我都不需要。
lines.en: I need nothing from the ground.
Ki lifts the dust.
I set it on the ledger stone.
Do not make me touch it.
I feel no weight at all.
You keep it.
Locked on; I will not lose you now.

lines.zh: 残影已经绕到你的侧后。
lines.en: An afterimage is already at your flank.

lines.zh: 你转身的方向我算到了。
lines.en: I predicted the way you would turn.
Ki runs from my soles to my fists.

lines.zh: 这一形态的速度你看不清。
lines.en: You cannot follow this form's speed.
How much ki do you have left?
I can feel you forcing yourself upright.
Do not dodge left.
My shadow is there.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸告诉我你在怕。
lines.en: Your breathing tells me you are afraid.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你已经在我范围里。
lines.en: No chase needed; you are in my range.
This time I give you no time.
I have sealed your way out.
I take half a step and the ground cracks.
Let us begin.

lines.zh: 那就现在开始，气已经聚满。
lines.en: Then let us begin; my ki is full.

lines.zh: 我在你左边留了个影子。
lines.en: I left a shadow on your left.
You struck air.
I have moved again.
Can you count how many I am?
Your weapon cannot catch afterimages.
No rush; the ki still climbs.
You give a step; I take two.
You raised the shield.
Your legs are still behind it.
I wait for your strength to empty.
I know this ground well.
You stepped into a crack.
My ki presses on your breathing.
How many breaths can you still hold?
I mean to end it in one pass.
Your shoulder is sinking.
Do not shut your eyes.
I am right here.

lines.zh: 我蓄气冲过去，撞进你怀里。
lines.en: I charge in with gathered ki.
The afterimage arrives first; the fist follows.
Ki blasts fire from my palm in a volley.
This fist bears down on your shield.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下来砸你的背。
lines.en: I drop from above onto your back.
An aerial combo leaves you only guarding.
Elbow, then knee.
You are driven back three blocks.
This blow carries the whole layer of ki.
Your weapon is knocked from your grip.
I punch in against your flank.
The ki wave throws up the dust.

lines.zh: 空中连击，你追不上我的影。
lines.en: In the air you cannot follow my shadow.
I used seven-tenths on that.
Your armor has caved in.
I pull back and wait for you to fall.

lines.zh: 沉睡的地方裂开一道光。
lines.en: A seam of light splits my resting place.
I wake, and the ki rushes out first.

lines.zh: 这具身体比睡着时更重。
lines.en: This body is heavier than when I slept.
Old dust still clings to the plate.
I step down from the dais.
This ground is my arena.

lines.zh: 气浪先把竞技场的灰吹开。
lines.en: My aura sweeps the arena dust aside.
The stones around me grow warm.
I raise a hand and look at it.
This is the second time I have woken.
Ki presses a ring into the ground.
Challenger, give your name.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己变了多少。
lines.en: I do not know how much I have changed.
I take one step toward the center.
Everything under my feet is ringing.
This form will not stay long.
So waste no time.
I draw the ki in a little.

lines.zh: 火缠上我的甲，气把它顶开。
lines.en: Fire clings to my plate; the ki pushes it off.

lines.zh: 落地时砸出一个坑，我撑住了。
lines.en: I land in a crater and hold.

lines.zh: 水在气层外翻，我仍往下沉。
lines.en: Water churns outside the ki; I still sink.
The blast tears through my ki shell.

lines.zh: 尖物穿过气层，扎进甲缝。
lines.en: Something pierces the ki and bites the seam.
That spell binds my ki tight.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是这形态耗得凶。
lines.en: I do not eat; this form simply burns fast.

lines.zh: 雷在我甲上炸开，气散了一半。
lines.en: Lightning bursts on my plate and half the ki scatters.
Everything beneath me is pulled away.
